Aubade · the Glass · the last night of winter

Candle Ice

An inquest in one night.

The ice is not a floor. It is a promise the water makes to the cold, and the water has never once kept it.Rime-folk saying

A detective story told almost entirely in conversation, in the spirit of Disco Elysium. Sixteen voices live in the Examiner’s head; what you say, what you fail, and who you listen to change what everyone else says back. Three to five hours. Turn the sound on for the music, the ice, and the voices in his head.
